# Direct Go calls to loGo/s methods with non-nil pointer parameters
# carry the nil check, but method values and interface calls do not:
# this is the documented hole, and the unchecked calls panic with
# the plain runtime error instead of the logos message.
env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
mkdir $WORK/bin

cd w
logos build ./...
logos build -o $WORK/bin/nilvalues$GOEXE ./g2/cmd
exec $WORK/bin/nilvalues$GOEXE
stdout 'method-direct: logos: nil from Go value'
stdout 'method-value: runtime error: invalid memory address or nil pointer dereference'
stdout 'iface: runtime error: invalid memory address or nil pointer dereference'
! stdout 'method-value: logos'
! stdout 'iface: logos'
cd ..

-- w/go.work --
go 1.27

use (
	./l2
	./g2
)

-- w/l2/go.mod --
module example.com/l2

go 1.27

-- w/l2/b/b.lgo --
package b

type User struct {
	Name string
}

type Box struct{}

func (b *Box) Set(u *User) string {
	return u.Name
}

type Setter interface {
	Set(u *User) string
}

-- w/g2/go.mod --
module example.com/g2

go 1.27

-- w/g2/q/q.go --
package q

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/l2/b"
)

func Run() string {
	out := ""
	func() {
		defer func() {
			if r := recover(); r != nil {
				out += "method-direct: " + fmt.Sprint(r) + "\n"
			}
		}()
		bb := &b.Box{}
		_ = bb.Set(nil)
		out += "method-direct: no-panic\n"
	}()
	func() {
		defer func() {
			if r := recover(); r != nil {
				out += "method-value: " + fmt.Sprint(r) + "\n"
			}
		}()
		bb := &b.Box{}
		m := bb.Set
		_ = m(nil)
		out += "method-value: no-panic\n"
	}()
	func() {
		defer func() {
			if r := recover(); r != nil {
				out += "iface: " + fmt.Sprint(r) + "\n"
			}
		}()
		var s b.Setter = &b.Box{}
		_ = s.Set(nil)
		out += "iface: no-panic\n"
	}()
	return out
}

-- w/g2/cmd/main.go --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/g2/q"
)

func main() { fmt.Print(q.Run()) }
